svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 150 x 80 mm, 2 mm 5052 aluminium, square. Round the corners

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 3 mm and deburr every edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the centre lines. The face that goes against the bin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lid is the top face; the box hangs under the other face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bolt holes: four 6.6 mm at 65 mm each side of the long centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line and 30 mm each side of the short one (130 x 60).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stud holes: four 4.2 mm at 40 mm and 18 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (80 x 36). Check the hole size on the stud maker's sheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press the four M4 x 12 flush-head studs in from the top face with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: press or a vice with smooth jaws, until the heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: top face flat on the lid underside; the box base sits flat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the lower face, the studs through its floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: studs square to the plate, heads flush, none turns by hand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Finish: prototype, none. Deployments: anodise before pressing
